movies.synopsisZh: 2026年最令人期待的暑假重頭戲！全球累積票房狂收近30億美元，彼思史上最賣座動畫系列《反斗奇兵》升級回歸！大家最熟悉的玩具朋友胡迪、巴斯光年、翠絲，將聯同新舊玩具對抗全新強敵，誓要與現今小朋友最沉迷的各式電子科技產品決一死戰！迪士尼與彼思《反斗奇兵5》由《海底奇兵》金像導演安德魯史坦頓執導，將於2026年6月18日起優先場，6月25日大銀幕上映。
movies.synopsisEn: The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time it’s Toy meets Tech. Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to what kids are obsessed with today...electronics!
movies.castZh: 聲演：湯漢斯、添亞倫、鍾古錫、Greta Lee、高倫奧拜恩
movies.castEn: Voice Cast: Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, Joan Cusack, Greta Lee, Conan O’Brien

movies.titleEn: The Last Song You Left Behind
movies.synopsisZh: 水嶋春人熱愛寫詩，某日被女主角遠坂綾音發現他這個不為人知的嗜好，綾音患有發展性閱讀障礙，讀寫文字十分困難，卻擁有卓越的歌唱與作曲才華。在綾音請求下，春人開始為她的音樂填詞，在一同創作歌曲的時光裡，彼此萌生愛意，才華讓他們彼此碰撞，卻也讓他們更珍惜對方——這是一部歷時十年、令人熱淚盈眶的愛情故事。
movies.synopsisEn: Haruto Mizushima secretly loves writing poetry. One day, his classmate Ayane Toosaka discovers his hidden hobby. Ayane has developmental dyslexia, which makes reading and writing extremely difficult for her, yet she possesses remarkable talent in singing and composing music. At Ayane's request, Haruto begins writing lyrics for her music. As they spend time creating songs together, they gradually develop feelings for each other. Their talents both clash and draw them closer, making them cherish one another even more—this is a love story spanning ten years that will move you to tears.
movies.castZh: 道枝駿佑、生見愛瑠、井上想良、田邊桃子、竹原Pistol、岡田浩暉、五頭岳夫、野間口徹、新羅慎二、宮崎美子、萩原聖人
movies.castEn: Shunsuke Michieda, Meru Nukumi, Sora Inoue, Momoko Tanabe, Pistol Takehara, Kohki Okada, Takeo Gozu, Toru Nomaguchi, Shinji Nira, Yoshiko Miyazaki, Masato Hagiwara

movies.synopsisZh: 環球影業榮譽呈獻全球矚目鉅製《奧德賽》（The Odyssey），是奧斯卡最佳導演基斯杜化路蘭繼《奧本海默》後的最新力作。全片採用IMAX技術拍攝，將荷馬筆下不朽動作史詩經典神話，搬上大銀幕。奧德修斯在特洛伊戰爭後，展開驚心動魄的返鄉征途，歷盡無窮無盡考驗，最終與摯愛重逢。《奧德賽》雲集超華麗卡士，包括麥迪文、湯姆賀倫、安妮夏菲慧、羅拔柏迪臣、雷碧達尼安高、辛蒂雅及查理絲花朗等。
movies.synopsisEn:
After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.
Written and directed by Christopher Nolan, The Odyssey is an epic fantasy adventure shot entirely with IMAX film cameras. The film stars Matt Damon as Odysseus, Tom Holland as Telemachus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Robert Pattinson as Antinous and Zendaya as Athena.
movies.castZh: 麥迪文、湯姆賀倫、安妮夏菲慧、羅拔柏迪臣、雷碧達尼安高、辛蒂雅、查理絲花朗
movies.castEn: Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong'o, Zendaya, Charlize Theron

movies.titleZh: 蜘蛛俠：英雄重生 (全景聲)
movies.synopsisZh:
繼《蜘蛛俠：不戰無歸》引發連場激戰後，彼得柏加（湯賀蘭 飾）為了守護大局，決定徹底「捨棄」原有身份，將自己從所有摯愛的記憶中完全抹除。四年過後，長大成人的彼得於紐約市過著真正「隱姓埋名」的生活。這位無名英雄如今化身為「全職蜘蛛俠」，日以繼夜守護著這個無人知曉他真實身份的城市。
點知守護者唔易做，長期爆肝壓力太大，竟然令佢身體竟然產生恐怖異變，甚至威脅生命！與此同時，一連串離奇罪案席捲紐約，而隱藏背後的，正是彼得有史以來最強大、最深不可測嘅宿敵⋯⋯
movies.synopsisEn: After the record-breaking global success of Spider-Man: No Way Home, Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he's devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
movies.castZh: 湯賀蘭、辛蒂雅、莎蒂辛克、積及巴特朗、莊柏恩瑟、崔梅爾提爾曼、麥可曼多、麥克雷法路
movies.castEn: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Tramell Tillman, Michael Mando, Mark Ruffalo

movies.synopsisZh:
由全球票房神話《愛你致死不渝》監製， 再續《命懸2000呎》恐懼奇蹟新高峰！
積絲因姐姐在2000呎高空電視塔的喪命意外後傷心不已，為了克服心魔，決心與姐姐生前好友露絲勇闖泰國，挑戰懸空3000呎的極限高空棧道，向姐姐無懼的冒險精神致敬。一場突如其來的山崩，二人被硬生生困於萬丈絕壁之上，半步差池定必粉身碎骨！當環境變幻莫測，幻覺幻聽不停來襲，陷入極致絕望窒息感……觀眾實時經歷手心冒汗，挑戰一場沉浸式嚇破膽的觀影體驗！
movies.synopsisEn: From the survival hit that tapped into the fear of heights and left two friends stranded at the top of a tower comes a climb that goes higher, gets deadlier, and hits with next-level adrenaline. In FALL 2: DEADPOINT, two friends take on new heights in Thailand, where unpredictable terrain, extreme exposure, and nowhere to hide push survival further than ever before.
movies.directorZh: 米高史派勒、彼得史派勒
movies.castZh: 哈莉特斯萊特、亞希瑪湯瑪斯、湯姆布蘭妮
movies.castEn: Harriet Slater, Arsema Thomas, Tom Brittney

movies.synopsisZh:
獲權威影評網站Rotten Tomatoes 96%超高分好評，影評一致推薦「年度最幽默電影」，辛丹斯電影節少少咸多多趣登場作！
祖（薛夫洛根 飾）與安琪拉（奧莉菲亞懷特 飾）早已失去激情，生活上事無大小針鋒相對，有交惡無交歡。今晚，他們誠邀樓上晚晚打得火熱的神秘鄰居翩娜（彭妮露古絲 飾）與霍克（愛德華諾頓 飾）共處一室，來一場始料不及的飯聚，豈料這對鄰居竟提出大膽又誘人的邀請？隨著夜色漸深，壓抑已久的慾望隨即噴發，四人一於敞開心口，開放性交友，事情發展高潮迭起，最後更一發不可收拾！究竟這是重新點燃乾涸的愛火花，還是成為摧毀關係的導火線？
movies.synopsisEn: Joe and Angela’s marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?
movies.castZh: 薛夫洛根、奧莉菲亞懷特、彭妮露古絲、愛德華諾頓
movies.castEn: Seth Rogen, Olivia Wilde, Penélope Cruz, Edward Norton

movies.titleZh: 劇場版 CHIIKAWA 人魚島的秘密 (日語版)
movies.titleEn: Chiikawa The Movie: The Secret Of The Mermaid Island (Japanese Version)
movies.synopsisZh:
某天，當吉伊卡哇與小八在廣場休息時，臉上貼著一張傳單的兔兔突然現身。
小八確認傳單後，發現那是一張寫著「特別島嶼邀請函」的招待券。
被傳單上誘人的條件所吸引，吉伊卡哇一行人決定前往島上合宿。
雖然海獺對傳單內容感到有些可疑，但仍與大家一同搭船出發。登陸小島後，吉伊卡哇一行人受到了島民們的熱烈歡迎。
正當吉伊卡哇他們度過愉快的時光時，卻得知了居住在島上的巨大「賽蓮」正在接連抓走島民的事實，並被迫捲入了討伐賽蓮的計劃之中。 接踵而來的考驗，朝著一心一意向前邁進的吉伊卡哇一行人襲來。
大家是否能夠齊心協力克服難關呢…!? 隱藏在這座島上真正的「秘密」又是什麼…!?
movies.synopsisEn:
One day, while Chiikawa and Hachiware are relaxing in the plaza, Usagi suddenly arrives with a flyer slapped onto Usagi's face. Checking the flyer, Hachiware discovers it is an invitation with the words: "An Invitation to a Special Island."
Lured by the tempting words on the flyer, Chiikawa and friends decide to join the island training camp. Boarding the ship alongside Rakko, who remains suspicious of the flyer's claims, the group sets foot on the island and receives a grand, warm welcome from the Island residents.
While spending a wonderful time together, Chiikawa and friends are suddenly told a shocking truth: a massive "Siren" living on the island has been abducting the Island residents one after another. Before long, the group gets swept into the plan to subjugate the Siren. Trial after trial awaits Chiikawa and the others as the group pushes forward with earnest determination.
Can everyone overcome these hardships together...?! And what exactly is the true "secret" hidden on this island...?!
movies.castZh: 聲演：青木遙、田中誠人、小澤亞李、井口裕香、淺井孝行、內田雄馬
movies.castEn: Voice Cast: Haruka Aoki, Makoto Tanaka, Ari Ozawa, Yuka Iguchi, Takayuki Asai, Yuma Uchida

movies.titleZh: 把哥哥變成可攜帶的尺寸
movies.titleEn: Bring Him Down to a Portable Size
movies.synopsisZh:
作家理子突然接到警方通知，得知哥哥猝然離世。前往哥哥居住的東北地區途中，理子不禁回想起與哥哥之間那些苦澀的往事。
在警察局裡，她時隔七年再次見到哥哥的前妻加奈子、女兒滿里奈，以及暫時由兒童保護服務機構照顧的良一，並一同將哥哥火化。
之後，三人著手整理哥哥一家人曾居住、如今已淪為垃圾屋的公寓。在牆上,他們看見一張張家族照片——有哥哥與理子年少時的合影，也有哥哥、加奈子、滿里奈與良一共同組成家庭後留下的照片...... 理子一邊收拾哥哥的遺物，一邊不斷說著哥哥的壞話。明明同樣曾被他牽連、受盡麻煩的加奈子，卻輕聲說道: 「或許，理子你也有一些不了解他的地方吧。」 當四人逐漸觸及那些從未知曉的事實,他們憤怒、歡笑，也悄悄落淚。重新思考「家人」究竟是什麼的四人，手忙腳亂的四天，就此展開——。
movies.synopsisEn:
Writer Riko receives a call from the police that her older brother has died unexpectedly. As she travels to where his brother had been living, painful memories of their troubled relationship begin to resurface.
Riko reunites for the first time in seven years with her brother's ex-wife, Kanako, his daughter Marina, and son Ryoichi, who is now in temporary child welfare care. As they clean out the garbage-filled apartment where his brother once lived, old photographs and forgotten belongings reveal unexpected truths about the man they thought they knew. Over four emotional days, the four confront grief, resentment, and long-buried memories, ultimately rediscovering what it means to be a family.
movies.castZh: 柴崎幸、小田切讓、滿島光、青山姬乃、味元耀大
movies.castEn: Ko Shibasaki, Joe Odagiri, Hikari Mitsushima, Aoyama Himeno, Yota Mimoto

movies.synopsisZh: 娥眉女足首戰「至尊無敵杯」，這支隊伍的隊員平均年齡超過三十，最初受到質疑。在高人指導下，她們獲得啟發，開始取得佳績。然而，在大勢向好之際卻因內部背叛而慘敗。經過反思，她們決定改變策略，成功晉級。在決賽面對衛冕多屆冠軍的勁旅，她們能否打破對方多年不敗的紀錄，實現奪冠的夢想？
movies.synopsisEn:
An unlikely women’s football team from Mount Emei is written off from the start — dismissed for their age, lack of experience, and slim chances of success. Everything changes when they unlock extraordinary martial arts-inspired abilities that transform their game, propelling them from underdogs to championship contenders.
But as victories mount and their dream of glory comes within reach, an unexpected betrayal threatens to tear the team apart. Forced to regroup after a crushing setback, they must rethink their strategy, overcome their differences, and rediscover the power of teamwork. Facing an undefeated reigning champion in the ultimate showdown, they will need more than extraordinary skills — they must outthink, outplay, and outmanoeuvre their opponents.
Can this unlikely team overcome the odds and achieve the impossible?
From visionary filmmaker Stephen Chow, Kung Fu Soccer delivers a crowd-pleasing blend of spectacular football action, martial arts fantasy, comedy, and heart — an uplifting story about friendship, perseverance, and the pursuit of the impossible.
movies.castZh: 張小斐、迪麗熱巴、張藝興
movies.castEn: Zhang Xiaofei, Dilraba Dilmurat, Zhang Yixing

movies.synopsisZh: 身為私房菜廚師，晚晚招呼自吹自擂識食的男顧客和相機先食的女顧客，面對經營壓力與失戀低潮，打開交友App 尋找心中的薩爾達公主，變成上門煮飯仔，也是非常合理的。車中泊的他，與四位不同背景的女生初次約會，精心設計菜單善待四顆寂寞的心，味蕾炸彈與情感價值兼備，同時解決身心需求，還勾起塵封的童年往事。黃浩然（《緣路山旮旯》）與鍾宏杰合導，以小本製作拍出久違的香港美食電影，娓娓道出庶民味道和合時令選材，才是最好的comfort food。
movies.synopsisEn: While trying to keep his struggling business afloat, a chef goes on a dating app in search of Zelda, his crush from his chatroom days as a teenager. For each Zelda he meets, he makes a tailor-made meal to fit their story. Putting a spotlight on the city’s struggling restaurant sector, indie filmmaker Amos WHY and his co-director Frankie Chung’s unconventional and bittersweet road movie follows a rootless man who turns to his memories to avoid confronting his unknown future. Is it better to drift with uncertainty, or to stay in your comfort zone whilst tethered to a sinking ship?
movies.castZh: 盧鎮業、楊偲泳、梁雍婷、張紋嘉、彭秀慧
movies.castEn: Lo Chun Yip, Renci Yeung, Rachel Leung, Crystal Cheung, Kearen Pang

movies.titleEn: Once Upon A Time In Middle East
movies.synopsisZh: 東北大廚徐福（沈騰 飾）為養家還債，扛著炒鍋跑去中東一家中餐館做廚師。他亮出龍抬頭、拔絲地瓜、宮保雞丁等各色中華美食，和前台經理馬俊生（蔣奇明 飾）一個掌勺一個攬客，把無人問津的龍餐館經營得風生水起！然而戰爭突然爆發，當地局勢急轉直下。亂世之中，各方勢力輪番登場，徐福的命運將會何去何從？戰火中的龍餐館又將如何維繫？
movies.synopsisEn:
Xu Fu (Shen Teng), a chef from Northeast China, heads to the Middle East to work at a Chinese restaurant. Carrying his wok, he hopes to support his family and pay off his debts. He serves up classic Chinese dishes: the Dragon‑Raising‑Its‑Head feast, candied sweet potatoes and Kung Pao chicken. He partners with restaurant manager Ma Junsheng (Jiang Qiming): Xu Fu handles the cooking, while Ma Junsheng takes care of guests. Together, they turn the little‑known Dragon Restaurant into a thriving spot.
War soon breaks out, and local conditions quickly turn dangerous. Different armed groups clash across the region. What will happen to Xu Fu? Can Dragon Restaurant survive amid the chaos of war?
movies.castZh: 沈騰、蔣奇明、奧馬爾 謝里夫、李治廷、謝里夫 薩比
movies.castEn: Shen Teng, Jiang Qiming, Omar Sherif, Aarif Rahman, Sherif Sobhy

movies.synopsisZh:
1986年7月27日，Queen於布達佩斯的 Népstadion 體育場舉行了一場創紀錄的巨型體育場演唱會，現場吸引了多達 8 萬名歌迷。這場演唱會是著名「Magic Tour」巡迴演出的一部分，同時也是主唱 Freddie Mercury 最後一次隨團進行巡迴演唱。
這部經典演唱會紀錄片已重製為 4K版本，並配上全新音效混音，重現多首樂隊代表作，包括《Bohemian Rhapsody》、《Crazy Little Thing Called Love》、《I Want To Break Free》及《We Are The Champions》。
在柏林圍牆倒塌的三年前，這是首個成功走進當時「鐵幕」背後的體育場舉行的西方搖滾樂團演唱會。對匈牙利當局及當地電影業而言，此舉具有舉足輕重的歷史意義，當局更特別召集了全國最頂尖的攝影師及技術團隊進行現場拍攝，為這場傳奇演出留下珍貴記錄。
切勿錯過《Queen Budapest》IMAX 版本，將於百老匯院線獨家限量放映！
movies.synopsisEn:
On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury.
Now, this original concert film has been beautifully rescanned and remastered in 4K alongside a dynamic new audio mix, featuring many of Queen's favorite tracks—"Bohemian Rhapsody,” "Crazy Little Thing Called Love," "I Want To Break Free” and "We Are The Champions." With three years to go before the fall of the Berlin Wall, this was the first Western rock concert performed in a stadium behind the then Iron Curtain. It was of such significance to the Hungarian authorities and film industry that a group of the country’s top film cameramen and technicians were brought together to film it for posterity.
Don’t miss Queen Budapest on IMAX screen and exclusive at Broadway Cinemas only !

movies.synopsisZh:
《Always Lalisa》是一部記錄全球巨星 LISA 的長篇紀錄片，捕捉她離開風靡全球、讓她躍升為世界知名表演者的 K-pop 現象級女團 BLACKPINK 後，歷經蛻變的一年。團體暫停活動後，LISA 正式展開個人事業的全新篇章，同時直面一個關鍵問題：卸下 BLACKPINK 的光環後，她究竟是誰？
本片記錄了 LISA 創作、錄音並發行首張個人專輯《Alter Ego》的歷程；同時見證她跨足影視圈，參演《白蓮花大飯店》第三季，以及全力備戰 2025 年 Coachella 音樂節的首次大型個人演出。在泰國土生土長的 LISA，14 歲便離鄉背井，遠赴南韓接受嚴格的 K-pop 訓練，最終躍升為風靡全球的超級巨星。然而，開創屬於自己的道路，尤其是在西方音樂市場，意味著要面對新的壓力、無所不在的放大檢視，以及按照自己的意志重新定義自我的挑戰。
私密、感性且真摯赤裸，《Always Lalisa》捕捉了一位站在人生十字路口的藝術家，記錄她充滿冒險與自我蛻變、探索的一年；LISA 不僅在定義人生的新篇章，更在一步步描繪自己渴望成為的女性與藝術家模樣。
movies.synopsisEn:
Always Lalisa is a feature-length documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from Blackpink, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. As the group pauses activities, LISA embarks on the first true chapter of her solo career, confronting the question of who she is beyond Blackpink.
The film follows LISA as she writes, records, and releases her debut solo album, Alter Ego, makes her acting debut in the third season of The White Lotus, and prepares for her first major solo performance at the 2025 Coachella Music Festival. Born and raised in Thailand, LISA left home at fourteen to train in South Korea's demanding K-pop system, ultimately rising to global superstardom. But forging her own path, particularly in the Western music market, brings new pressures, relentless scrutiny, and the challenge of redefining herself on her own terms.
Intimate, emotional, and revealing, Always Lalisa captures an artist at a crossroads, documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define not only her next chapter, but the woman and artist she wants to become.
